summary: John's maternal great-grandmother, wife of James Petriello; daughter of Bisaccia immigrants Frank Giannetta and the foundling Angelica Ferrantino.
bio: The Ancestry tree showed only 'Mollie Petriello 1911-' as James's wife; Round 1 initially wondered if Mollie = Mary Cognetti and then corrected that (Mollie b. 1911 is James's wife and John T.'s mother; maiden name unknown). Round 2 solved her identity: Carmela 'Mollie' Gianetta, b. 13 Jul 1910 Dunmore, d. 7 Feb 2000 Scranton (FS tree GQ4M-KCR, 6 sources incl. 1950 census 'Mollie Petriello' and SSDI 'Mollie C Petriello', the C = Carmela). The tree's 1911 should be 1910. On the 1931 marriage license (No. 1107, sworn 20 Jun 1931) she is 'Mollie Genett', 20, housework, born Dunmore, living at 133 Sand St; father Frank, a blacksmith born in Italy, living in Dunmore; mother Angeli(c)a, maiden name Ferrandino, born in Italy. Her mother 'Angelina Genett' consented because she was a minor. Married at Dunmore in July 1931 (FS: 12 Jul 1931) by Rev. Michael DeLarno. 133 Sand St was also her father's address on his 1920 Declaration of Intention. Her siblings were Savino (1897-1964), Mariano Martin (1899-1941), Maria (1902), Antonio (1907-1998), Giuseppe (1912-1971), Rosa (1914) and Charles J. (1916-1975).
